description.p: Pro Clock is a fast, native desktop time tracker built in Rust with zero cloud dependencies, no accounts, and all data stored locally in a single SQLite database.

ul.li: Live stopwatch timer and manual time entry with crash-safe SQLite persistence
Weekly timesheet grid with rapid duration entry
Built-in Pomodoro focus timer with desktop notifications and cycle tracking
Unlimited projects, clients, tags, and 3-tier billable hourly rates
Visual reports, daily charts, and Clockify-compatible CSV and JSON export
Ubuntu Yaru and Windows 11 Fluent Dark and Light themes plus offline Help & Guide

description.p: Added Windows 11 Fluent Dark and Light themes alongside Ubuntu Yaru, built-in offline Help & Guide, and Linux/Windows packaging.
